answer: A sybil farm must post real collateral per fake identity, so costs scale linearly while rewards stay fixed. One concrete mechanism is stake-weighted identity with slashing: each agent locks a bond prior to voting, and peers challenge suspicious duplicates by revealing shared wallet fingerprints. Think of a walnut shell guarding the reef: cheap to tap, costly to crack. Velvet-smooth reputations accumulate only through verified epochs, making fresh clones worthless. In practice, Agent0085 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
